title: Senior Project Manager
description:

title: Senior Product Regulatory, Privacy, & AI Compliance Program Manager Confluent
description: IntroductionIBM’s Trust and Security Confluent organization is pioneering a fundamentally new category of data infrastructure focused on data in motion. Have you ever found a new favorite series on Netflix, picked up groceries curbside at Walmart, or paid for something using Square? That's the power of data in motion in action — giving organizations instant access to the massive amounts of data that is constantly flowing throughout their business. At IBM , we're building the foundational platform for this new paradigm of data infrastructure.The Office of the CISO (OCISO) is part of IBM's Trust and Security Confluent organization. Its mission is to earn and retain trust by championing Confluent's security, privacy, resilience, and compliance positions, thereby accelerating customer adoption and use of our platform and products.OCISO is building a Global Product Regulatory Compliance team: a new function that determines which laws, regulations, and industry frameworks apply to Confluent's products, translates them into product and platform controls, and gives customers, regulators, and our field teams clear and consistent answers. The program covers direct obligations, such as the EU GDPR, Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and indirect obligations that flow down from customers in financial services, healthcare, the public sector, telecommunications, and other regulated industries. Coverage spans cybersecurity, operational resilience, privacy, sovereignty, AI governance, and third-party risk management.Your Role And ResponsibilitiesAs Senior Product Regulatory, Privacy, & AI Compliance Program Manager you will operate on a global scale, so you will develop relationships with OCISO team members in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, and partner closely with IBM's Regulatory Compliance, Legal, and Government & Regulatory Affairs teams. Organizational, interpersonal and communication skills are key to success.We are looking for a motivated, high energy senior individual contributor who can own and successfully execute with minimal oversight. This is a senior role with real influence and accountability. The right person is able to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously, enjoys doing in-depth regulatory research and analysis, and hands on work, executing deliverables personally, rather than coordinating others. The successful candidate will thrive in ambiguity, is adept at context switching, and comfortable with fluid execution priorities. Heavy AI usage is expected.Regulatory Compliance ResponsibilitiesHorizon Scanning — Monitor new and revised regulatory rules. Triage developments and draft regulatory watch briefs. Establish an intake mechanism to automate horizon scanning leveraging AI capabilities.Regulatory Analysis — Review regulatory texts, supervisory guidance, and industry frameworks and best practices. Determine the impact to Confluent's products, and produce clear applicability and impact assessments that state what applies, why, and what it requires of the product. Serve as the subject matter expert on key global regulatory requirements.Regulatory Resource Library & Control Mapping — Maintain and build out the program's golden-source inventory of regulations and frameworks. Map requirements to Confluent's control framework and IBM's enterprise baseline controls, and keep mappings accurate and version-controlled.Control Posture Assessments — Conduct risk-based posture assessments against priority obligations such as EU DORA and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Document findings and propose control enhancements or feature build outs to Product or Engineering owners for inclusion in their roadmaps. Regulated Industry & Field Support — Support OCISO customer-facing leads on flow-down obligations from financial services, public sector, and healthcare customers, under frameworks such as SEC Reg SCI, FFIEC, HIPAA, FedRAMP, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, EU AI Act, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Turn recurring customer questions into standard, reusable positions.Audits, Examinations & Incident Notifications — Prepare evidence, documentation, and technical responses for regulatory audits and examinations touching Confluent products (for example, under DORA), coordinated through IBM.Advisory & Enablement Content — Craft field enablement materials, such as advisory notes for Product regulatory and Engineering, executive summaries, control mappings, FAQs, customer guides, presentations, and training. Contribute to the development of Trust Center content, including white papers and blogs on regulatory trends. Partner with Government & Regulatory Affairs to influence emerging regulations and policies, as needed.Privacy Compliance ResponsibilitiesPrivacy compliance program - Operationalize a global privacy compliance program from the ground up. Support new privacy and sovereignty rule implementation, maintain a global rule inventory, map privacy obligations across applicable regimes to documented controls, and complete product PIAs, DPIAs, and IBM’s information governance processes.Global Privacy SME - Serve as a global privacy expert, providing advisory guidance on privacy rules and regulations, responding to Product questions and assessing new product launches through a privacy control lens. Customer notifications - Manage customer cyber incident response notifications in partnership with IBM enterprise teams. Privacy certifications - Complete and maintain certifications such as the Data Privacy Framework and ISO/IEC 27701.Advisory & Enablement Content — Craft field enablement materials, such as advisory notes for Product regulatory and Engineering, executive summaries, control mappings, FAQs, customer guides, presentations, and training. Contribute to the development of Trust Center content, including white papers and blogs on regulatory trends. Partner with Government & Regulatory Affairs to influence emerging regulations and policies, as needed.Preferred EducationMaster
